messages.subject: UT Austin Student Highly Interested in Aeris Partners' Summer 2025 Internship
messages.body:
Hello Aeris Recruiting Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am emailing to emphasize my interest in
recruiting at Aeris Partners for the Summer Analyst 2025 Program. I am
from Los Angeles, and I'm now studying Economics and Business at the
University of Texas - Austin. I'm sure your firm doesn't receive many
applications from UT students, if any at all, so I wanted to send this
email to reaffirm my interest in Aeris, having already submitted my online
application.

A week ago, a close friend of mine studying at USC Marshall shared with me
that Aeris had directly reached out to him for recruitment purposes. This
conversation piqued my interest in your firm. I have since spent some time
learning more about Aeris Partners. My interest is twofold:

1) I am particularly interested in boutique tech banks. Aeries stands out
as a SaaS M&A bank as I believe very strongly in the future of the SaaS
industry.
2) Through learning more about your firm through talking to my buddy who
had a coffee chat with Aeris and your website, it is abundantly clear that
your firm places a tremendous emphasis on company culture and personal
fit, transcending beyond the superficial culture narrative of most banks.
This is very unique to your firm and genuinely appeals to me.

I hope I have demonstrated my sincere interest in your firm and you
consider my application. I also attached my resume below.

Best,
Jonathan Nachman

Hello Aeris Recruiting Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am emailing to emphasize my interest in recruiting at Aeris Partners for the Summer Analyst 2025 Program. I am from Los Angeles, and I'm now studying Economics and Business at the University of Texas - Austin. I'm sure your firm doesn't receive many applications from UT students, if any at all, so I wanted to send this email to reaffirm my interest in Aeris, having already submitted my online application.

A week ago, a close friend of mine studying at USC Marshall shared with me that Aeris had directly reached out to him for recruitment purposes. This conversation piqued my interest in your firm. I have since spent some time learning more about Aeris Partners. My interest is twofold:

1) I am particularly interested in boutique tech banks. Aeries stands out as a SaaS M&A bank as I believe very strongly in the future of the SaaS industry.
2) Through learning more about your firm through talking to my buddy who had a coffee chat with Aeris and your website, it is abundantly clear that your firm places a tremendous emphasis on company culture and personal fit, transcending beyond the superficial culture narrative of most banks. This is very unique to your firm and genuinely appeals to me.

I hope I have demonstrated my sincere interest in your firm and you consider my application. I also attached my resume below.

Best,
Jonathan Nachman

Thank you for taking the time to do a technical interview with our team. You did very well and we would like to move forward in the interview process. We would love to hear your thoughts on the conversation!

The next step is an industry-specific and behavioral interview over Teams, so if you are interested in moving forward, please let me know your availability for next week.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Thanks,
Paige

messages.subject: Industry-Specific / Behavioral Interview with Aeris Partners
Inquiring About Timeline of Recruiting Process
messages.body:
Good Evening Paige,

I hope this email finds you well and that you've had an enjoyable week. I first want to express my gratitude for the opportunity to have had my 2nd round interview with Gabriel on Monday. I enjoyed the opportunity to learn more about the firm and how I can potentially contribute in the future.

I am emailing in regards to the timeline of my recruitment process with Aeris. Specifically, I want to gently ask if there might be any updates regarding the potential next steps in the recruitment timeline. I remain highly enthusiastic about the possibility of joining Aeris and would love to continue this process if possible.

I look forward to hearing from you soon. Please let me know if there is anything you require from me in the meantime.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: RE: Inquiring About Timeline of Recruiting Process
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Thank you for reaching out! We should have an updated timeline for our San Francisco candidates by early next week. Please let me know if you have any competing offer deadlines we should be aware of in case we need to expedite the process on our end.

Have a great weekend!

Best,
Paige
